adapters.hints: On /overview press 'API Keys'. On /api-keys press 'Create key', type the supplied key_name fact (grunt-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS with a unique suffix) in 'Alias' so it differs from existing keys, leave 'Spend limit' and 'Expiration date' empty, press 'Create'. The new key is shown once in the dialog; press its 'Copy' button so it is stored, then finish. Never press a 'Revoke' button.

On /dashboard press 'API keys … Manage keys'. On /dashboard/api-keys press 'Show plaintext key'. In its dialog press 'Send code'. After 'Send code' the code is already on its way: read the inbox now (never wait) for the Token Harbor verification email, type its code in 'Verification code' and press 'Verify'. When the plaintext key is shown, the next action is to press 'Copy plaintext key' (never wait, never finish first); it stores the key. Then finish. Do not press '+ New key', 'Edit', 'Revoke' or 'Hide plaintext key'.
On console.mistral.ai/codestral/cli/authenticate press 'Authorize'. When the page then shows no controls, the CLI pairing is done: finish.

Open the grunt project (use 'Switch project' if another project is open), then 'Settings' in the project sidebar, then 'Observability settings' (/settings/observability). There the 'Agent observability' switch must be off: turn it off if it is on. Leave 'PII redaction' and 'Data region' unchanged, then finish. On /cli/confirm-auth ('Link project to LiveKit CLI'): press 'Project', choose grunt, then press 'Allow access'. After 'Allow access' is pressed it stays disabled while the CLI links: choose WAIT until the page shows 'Access granted'; never press it again. Once that page shows 'Access granted', the CLI pairing is complete: choose DONE now.

On /keys: if 'Save' has not been pressed yet in this drive, press 'Edit secret key', set Budget to 0, check 'Quest balance only', leave only 'Generate' on, and press 'Save'. If 'Save' has already been pressed in this drive, the goal is complete: choose DONE now. The key list shown after Save is the confirmation of the saved settings, so no further click is needed. Never press 'Create', 'Delete secret key' or a second 'Edit secret key'.

On /sign-in press 'Continue with Google' and choose the Squire-connected Google account. Leave 'Username or email' and 'Password' empty; they belong to password login, not to Google sign-in. After Google returns, /oauth/google can show only 'Back to sign in' while it signs in: wait there; do not press 'Back to sign in'. After sign-in open /dashboard/apikeys and create one key named grunt; the shown key is stored automatically.

On /overview open 'API Keys' (/keys). Press 'Buat API Key' (create), open 'Pengaturan lanjutan' (advanced), choose 'Model tertentu' (specific model), type the model ID this goal names into 'Cari model...' and tick its checkbox, type grunt as the name, press the create button. The new key is shown once: press its copy button so it is stored, then finish. Never press 'Ganti key' (rotate) or 'Cabut key' (revoke).

On /keys type grunt in 'Key name', keep 'Free · prompts kept' selected, check the 'I agree to the Terms' checkbox, press 'Create key'. The new key (prefix sk-gm-free-) is shown with 'Copy key': press 'Copy key' so it is stored, then finish.

On /account/signup type the Squire email in the email field and a new password in the password field, choose 'Google Search' in the 'Select an option' list, press 'Create Account with $0.50 free-model credit', then complete the emailed verification and create one key named grunt; press its copy button so it is stored.

On the home page press 'Mulai Gratis' (start free). On /masuk?mode=register type grunt in 'Nama Anda' (name), the Squire email in the email field and press 'Kirim OTP' (send code). After 'Kirim OTP' read the inbox now, never type first: the six-digit Darus OTP is in the email, and reading the inbox fills the code field '______'. Then type grunt in 'username', a new password in 'Min. 12 karakter, kuat', leave the referral field 'Mis. 5UHRWNL8' empty, and press 'Daftar sekarang' (register). Then create one key named grunt.

On /login.html press 'Continue with Google' and choose the Squire-connected account. Then open 'Chat' (/chat-app/) and press 'Dashboard': the account API key is shown there with a 'Copy' button. Press 'Copy' so it is stored, then finish; there is no create step.

On /signup, when the page lists neither an Email field nor 'Create my key', the signup form is still loading: choose WAIT (never press 'Get started', 'Sign in' or 'Refresh availability'). When the Email field shows the Squire email, complete the Cloudflare check and press 'Create my key'. While 'Create my key' is disabled after the press, wait. The new key is shown once with a 'Copy key' button: press 'Copy key' so it is stored, then finish. On /dashboard never press 'Copy' (it copies the invite link, not the key), 'Rotate key' or 'Delete account'.

On github.com/login/device/select_account press 'Continue as' the account Squire uses for GitHub. On /login/device type the device code from this goal into the 'User code' boxes (one character each), press 'Continue', then 'Authorize'.
